name: Amount display
purpose: The money-format PRIMITIVE: renders a currency value consistently — currency symbol/code before the amount with no space (copy-025), tabular lining figures so columns of money align, an unambiguous U+2212 minus for negatives, and a redacted privacy state. Monochrome by design; directional gain/loss colour is owned by the RAG/delta colour workstream and layers on later. Everything from account balances to transaction rows to data-grid numeric cells composes on this atom.

tokens.type-display: composite .t-cm-figure-4 (32px / 400 / line-height 1 / tabular-nums) — the display/amount type token, PREPARED 2026-07-19 awaiting Dave's vouch
tokens.$directional-out-of-scope: REVIEW: directional gain/loss colour (data/delta/gain + data/delta/loss) is deliberately NOT bound here — colour is handled in the RAG/delta workstream and layers on as an opt-in modifier later. Contrast note kept for when it lands: dark-loss #CC4333 = 4.42:1 fails AA-text, so a directional treatment must keep the numeric value monochrome and carry direction by caret + sign (avd-001).

commonPatterns: right-aligned money column in a table
transaction amount in a statement row

accessibility.role: Passive text by default. The redacted variant uses role="img" + aria-label so the masked value announces its meaning ('Balance hidden') rather than reading the dots.
accessibility.screenReader: The U+2212 minus reads as 'minus'. Currency symbol/code precedes the value (copy-025). A screen reader reads '£3,248.55' acceptably; a consuming component may add an explicit aria-label (e.g. 'Balance £3,248.55') where the surrounding context needs it.
accessibility.colourIndependence: No meaning is carried by colour anywhere in this atom (it is monochrome); sign and magnitude are text. When the directional modifier lands from the colour workstream, direction must remain carried by caret + sign, not colour alone (1.4.1).

antiPatterns: Putting a space between the currency symbol/code and the amount (copy-025 — a space risks the amount wrapping to a different line).
Using proportional (non-tabular) figures — money columns must align; the atom sets font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums.
Using a hyphen-minus (-) instead of U+2212 MINUS (−) for negatives.
Conveying credit/debit or gain/loss by COLOUR alone — this atom is monochrome; when directional colour is added it must be redundant with a sign/caret (1.4.1).
Hard-coding the display size instead of binding to the .t-cm-figure-4 composite once it is vouched.
Hiding a balance with opacity — use the redacted variant (a real token colour + aria-label), never an opacity tint (it drifts per surface).
